objective: Count how many of the specified products have at least 4 items available today in the Bratislava Stare Mesto hardware store.

params.store_id: lookup from stores where city = 'Bratislava' and store_name = 'Stare Mesto hardware branch'
params.product_skus: discover property keys and value formats from product_variant_properties for the relevant product families, then for each product description (brand, series, model, product kind, and property conditions like fastener type, screw type, diameter, storage type) query product_variants joining product_families and product_kinds to obtain the matching product_sku(s)
